message: Explain in three short points how emotion-aware AI can help customer support.
sample_reply:
1. Detects customer emotions in text or voice to identify frustration, anger, or happiness, enabling faster and more empathetic responses. 
2. Adjusts tone and response style in real time to de-escalate tense situations and build trust. 
3. Provides agents with emotional context, improving decision-making and personalization during support interactions.
